source_boundary.strategy_scope: owner-approved current P90 REAL strategy versions only; unrelated strategies retain independent existing source policy
source_boundary.native_publication_boundary: the original R06 source event (frame_number,frame_index) must not exceed this MarketPublication native_watermarks[symbol] source cursor; when equal, original exec_id and exchange_sequence must match the watermark, never synthesize a post-publication event
source_boundary.plan_and_producer_identity: the request EntryPlan/ExitPlan must exactly match the durable R06 Strategy checkpoint; its producer_release_commit must equal the referenced immutable MarketPublication producer commit; no surrogate source approval by matching StrategyVersion alone
source_boundary.single_active_native_epoch: R07 read-only proof must match R06 _one_pin: exactly one ACTIVE native source session per shared MarketSource; source session producer_release_commit must match the MarketPublication producer commit and durable Strategy checkpoint producer commit
source_boundary.freshness_source: existing P90 REAL v3 immutable EntryPlan maximum request age; not a new Strategy threshold
source_boundary.missing_or_mixed_proof: fail closed before financial permission check or command creation
source_boundary.commit_time_recheck: R07 source epoch transaction SHARED guard is acquired before the final source proof and held until command + dispatch transaction commit; DB-side postgres-installed trigger acquires transaction EXCLUSIVE on original native source-session identity/state transitions. Exact mutable R06 checkpoint rows are FOR SHARE until command commit; missing/disabled ABI, lock failure or rejected source proof blocks new Entry. R06 SOURCE_ONLY financial request generation remains forbidden.
source_boundary.post_final_read_race_evidence: Pre-fix PR #659 disposable PG16 showed source GAP committing after final SELECT and before synthetic command. PR #666 verified the separate transaction lock as a fixture-only spike. Current source migration + R07 code reproduce both orders and lock the mutable R06 checkpoint in disposable PG16; production deployment/runtime verification is a separate gate.
source_boundary.epoch_guard_sql: operations/sql/20261114_r07_source_epoch_transaction_guard.sql (additive authorized postgres migration, source role grants unchanged)
source_boundary.guard_lock_abi: CRIPTA:R07:SOURCE_EPOCH_TRANSITION:V1:<market_source_id>, pg_catalog.hashtextextended(key,0); EXCLUSIVE pg_advisory_xact_lock in database source trigger, SHARED pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared in Consumer command transaction
source_boundary.checkpoint_row_lock: FOR SHARE OF cp only during final command/dispatch transaction, compatible with existing R06 checkpoint UPDATE role grants; early read is SELECT-only and cannot create financial permission
